description: The naming scope of Brand expressive: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: naming.values
answers.why: Lowercase paths read the same everywhere.

usage.use: The closest semantic token, then ask for a new one
usage.not: A raw value in the component
usage.why: The next campaign changes primitives; raw values would stay behind.
